scope: machine-observable preservation of verified DOCX source contracts in PDF

terminology.source_value_fidelity: the author-relevant value or structure specified by the DOCX contract is retained
terminology.machine_observable_semantic_preservation: the destination expresses the contracted accessibility relation in a PDF representation accepted by this feature rule
terminology.verified_accepted_equivalent: an alternate PDF encoding accepted only when the required relation is independently evidenced
terminology.abstention: UNRESOLVED_EQUIVALENCE or MEASUREMENT_ERROR when evidence cannot support a safe decision

headings.source_property: paragraph heading levels, text, and order
accepted_pdf: H1-H6 structure elements with matching sequence and level
a documented equivalent role mapping resolving to H1-H6
required_evidence: source text where the contract includes it
headings.altered: heading level or author-relevant text differs
headings.lost: corroborated absence of required heading representation
headings.abstain: role mapping or text association is not recoverable

accepted_pdf: Figure with /Alt equal to the contract value
alt_text.partial: figure survives but required value is incomplete
alt_text.altered: Figure remains but source string changes; this is fidelity, not an automatic usability claim
alt_text.lost: corroborated absence of Figure and equivalent image description
alt_text.abstain: image identity or alternate representation cannot be resolved

lists.source_property: list type, item order/text, nesting depth, and parent relation
accepted_pdf: L/LI/LBody hierarchy with ListNumbering where needed
a role-mapped equivalent with item correspondence
required_evidence: item text/order when contract requires it
lists.partial: container or item structure survives incompletely
lists.altered: type, order, text, or nesting differs
lists.abstain: item correspondence or ordered/unordered type is unavailable

basic_tables.source_property: table dimensions, cell values, and header-row relation
accepted_pdf: Table with TH/TD structure and recoverable header relation
basic_tables.partial: table survives but a required relation/value is incomplete
basic_tables.altered: cell/header value or required relation differs
basic_tables.lost: corroborated absence of required table structure

accepted_pdf: catalog/structure-root /Lang with normalized equivalent language tag
document_language.partial: language exists only at a weaker/partial scope
document_language.altered: language tag changes under exact-value contract

inline_language.source_property: run-level language override and associated text span
accepted_pdf: Span/structure element with /Lang covering the contracted text
inline_language.partial: only part of the span or relation survives
inline_language.lost: no corroborated inline marker for a non-default source span

decorative_images.source_property: explicit decorative versus meaningful image state
accepted_pdf: Figure with required /Alt for meaningful source
decorative_images.partial: image state is present but association is incomplete
decorative_images.altered: decorative state changes to meaningful or vice versa
decorative_images.lost: corroborated absence of the source image state

hyperlinks.source_property: URI, visible name, and their association
accepted_pdf: Link structure element associated with a URI annotation and visible span
hyperlinks.partial: URI or link role survives without complete name association
hyperlinks.altered: URI or contracted visible name changes
hyperlinks.abstain: geometry/text association is not independently resolvable

document_metadata.source_property: core title/subject/keywords and visible identity where contracted
accepted_pdf: PDF document information/XMP fields with normalized equivalent values
document_metadata.lost: corroborated absence of a required metadata field
document_metadata.abstain: only one metadata namespace is observable

complex_tables.source_property: multi-level header grouping, spans, and associations
accepted_pdf: Table/TH/TD plus scope/headers/span attributes that recover the source relation
complex_tables.partial: table/header roles survive but a required association is incomplete
complex_tables.lost: corroborated absence of complex table structure
complex_tables.abstain: presence of TH alone cannot establish multi-level equivalence

accepted_pdf: Note structure with recoverable reference/body relation
an equivalent link/parent-tree relation documented by evidence
footnotes.partial: note or reference survives without the complete relation
footnotes.lost: only when the required relation is representable and corroborated absent
footnotes.abstain: Note is present but reference/body mapping is not recoverable

accepted_pdf: Formula structure with recoverable equivalent expression/tokens
ActualText only when it is demonstrably the contracted mathematical representation
equations.partial: Formula exists but only part of structure is recoverable
equations.altered: expression or contracted token structure differs
equations.lost: corroborated absence of formula structure when visible glyphs remain
equations.abstain: visible text alone cannot establish mathematical structure

accepted_pdf: Caption structure associated with the intended Figure
captions.partial: caption text survives but relation is only adjacency
captions.lost: corroborated absence of caption and association
captions.abstain: page adjacency cannot prove semantic association
